l.i: tra Allatium de consensu Græcæ Roma-

main_text.l: properaret oratio, en ecce ad me literæ Il-
vnaque cum iis Disputatio Apologetica Hot-
tingeri contra Leonem Allatium de con-
siarum perpetuo. Non est quod amplius di-
cam, actutum attento animo lectioni me
dedi, neque intermisi, donec ad exitum
Disputatio illa adducta est: Quid tum?

page.notes: Printed words are all transcribed. "vt" is normalised to "ut" in the text as per the u/v rule (it appears as "vt" in the last line; it is written as ut).
